y-m-76-08.topic: Sample survey: kutaura nezvechose kubva pa sample defect rate
y-m-76-08.goal: Ratio inowanikwa kubva pa sample ingori kufanofungidzira kumwe chete kweratio yechose; shanda kuti ma ratios ose api asingapokani nemhedzisiro iyi, uye utaure kuti chii chimwe chinofanira kuzikanwa.
y-m-76-08.material:
Bhokisi rimwe refekitori yezvikamu rine zvikamu 5,000. Inspector akatora 50 zvisina kurongwa kubva mubhokisi akadzitarisa, uye 1 yaiva ne defect (sample defect rate 2%). Manager akapa mushumo, 'Bhokisi iri rine zvikamu 100 zvine defect.' Tafura iri pazasi inoratidza 'mukana wekuti, kana tichifungidzira kuti defect rate chaiyo yebhokisi rose ndeiyi, 1 kana pasi dzine defect dzibude kana 50 dzatorwa zvisina kurongwa' (makosha akaverengwa kare).
Defect rate 1%: anenge 91.1%, 2%: anenge 73.6%, 5%: anenge 27.9%, 8%: anenge 8.3%, 12%: anenge 1.3%.

y-m-76-03.material: Mumusha wekuchengetera zvekuchenesa mune concentrate yekuchenesa inouraya utachiona. Chikwangwani chechigadziko chinongoti 'dilute 1:10 usati washandisa'. Tinoda kugadzira 1 L (1,000 mL) yemvura yakasanganiswa. Mvura iyi concentrate yakasanganiswa nemvura chete, uye huwandu hwose hunotorwa sehuwandu hwemavolume maviri akasanganiswa.
y-m-76-03.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa kutonga nguva imwe neimwe apo ruzivo rutsva rwunouya
y-m-76-03.prereq.1: Zvinoreva ratio nemwero, mitaurire inoenderana (ukuru hwegiredhi rekutanga rechikoro chepakati)
y-m-76-03.prereq.2: Hukama hwemayuniti evolume L ne mL (1 L = 1,000 mL)
y-m-76-03.s.s1.prompt: Tinogona kusarudza kuti concentrate yemL mangani yekuisa kubva pamashoko echikwangwani oga here?
y-m-76-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kune nzira yega yega yekuverenga, fungidzira huwandu hweconcentrate kana uchigadzira 1 L uye uvaenzanise pakati pavo.
y-m-76-03.s.s1.o.a: Hatigoni kusarudza. Tinofanira kuziva kuti 1 ne10 mu 1:10 zvinoreva chii imwe neimwe.
y-m-76-03.s.s1.o.b: Tinogona kusarudza. Kana i1:10, concentrate ichikamu chimwe chekumi chehuwandu hwose, saka 100 mL.
y-m-76-03.s.s1.r.b: Wakaverenga 1:10 se 'concentrate : huwandu hwose'. Hauna kusiya mukana wekuti inogona kuverengwawo se 'concentrate : mvura'.
y-m-76-03.s.s1.o.c: Tinogona kusarudza. Pane 10 yemvura kune 1 yeconcentrate, saka inenge 91 mL.
y-m-76-03.s.s1.r.c: Kuiverenga se 'concentrate : mvura' kunogoneka, asi kunze kwekunge chikwangwani chichiti, wakasarudza nzira imwe chete.
y-m-76-03.s.s1.o.d: Hatigoni kusarudza. Tinofanira kuziva hukuru hwechigadziko kusarudza huwandu hweconcentrate.
y-m-76-03.s.s1.r.d: Wakataura ruzivo rwunodiwa, asi hahuna chekuita nezvinoreva ratio. Zvatotaurwa kuti tinogadzira 1 L.
y-m-76-03.s.s1.explain: Kana 1:10 i 'concentrate : mvura', concentrate i1000 ÷ 11 ≈ 91 mL, uye kana i 'concentrate : huwandu hwose', i100 mL, saka makosha akasiyana. Kana chikwangwani chisingataure kuti ndeipi, hatigoni kusarudza imwe.
y-m-76-03.s.s2.prompt: Nguva imwe neimwe apo ruzivo rutsva rwunouya, gadzirisa kutonga kwako nezvehuwandu hweconcentrate.
y-m-76-03.s.s2.hint.0: Panhanho yega yega, nyora mumutsara mumwe zvakagadziriswa neruzivo rwakangosvika.
y-m-76-03.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga mugove weconcentrate wesarudzo imwe neimwe (concentrate ÷ 1,000) uye uuenzanise nemwero we9.09%.

y-m-76-03.s.s2.st.0.o.c: Inogona kuva 91 mL kana 100 mL, saka hatigoni kusarudza zvino
y-m-76-03.s.s2.st.1.info: Takawana zvinyorwa zvidiki kuseri kwechikwangwani. 'Wedzera zvikamu 10 zvemvura kuchikamu 1 checoncentrate uye usanganise.'
y-m-76-03.s.s2.st.1.after: Neconcentrate chikamu 1 nemvura zvikamu 10, huwandu hwose zvikamu 11, saka concentrate i1000 ÷ 11 ≈ 90.9 mL.
y-m-76-03.s.s2.st.1.r.a: Uku kukosha kunobva pakuverenga 1:10 se concentrate : huwandu hwose. Kuseri kunoti zvikamu 10 zvemvura 'zvinowedzerwa'.
y-m-76-03.s.s2.st.1.r.b: Uku kukosha kwe concentrate : mvura = 1 : 9. Yakati mvura i10.

y-m-76-03.s.s2.st.2.after: 100 mL i10%, inopfuura mwero uye inoenderana neka. Inenge 91 mL yakarurama asi ine kukanganisa kwekuona. Pasi pemamiriro umo isingafanire kushaya, kutonga kwekurunga kumusoro kwakachengeteka.
y-m-76-03.s.s2.st.2.r.a: 90 mL i9% yehuwandu hwose, inoshaya mwero (inenge 9.09%).
y-m-76-03.s.s2.reflect: Pakutanga paiva nemakosha maviri zvichienderana nekuverenga, wobva watsananguro yekuseri yasarudza nzira yekuverenga, uye pakupedzisira chishandiso chekuyera nemamiriro e 'haafanire kushaya' zvakachinja huwandu hwekupedzisira. Ngatisiyanise kuti ruzivo rwakachinja 'kukosha' kana 'mamiriro'.
y-m-76-03.s.s3.prompt: Nyora zvakare mashoko echikwangwani kuti pasave nekusanzwisisika. Zviite kuti mushandi averenge mutsara mumwe chete ndokuutevera pakarepo.

y-m-76-03.s.s3.hint.1: Fungidzira kana kuisa muenzaniso mumwe (nenhamba) mumabracket kuchijekesa.
y-m-76-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Kuverenga mashoko aya oga, unogona kuverenga kuti concentrate yemL mangani inodiwa kugadzira 1 L here?
y-m-76-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakaiverenga iwe amene kuona kana pane nzvimbo yasara yekuiverenga zvakasiyana here?
y-m-76-03.s.s3.model.0: Sanganisa zvikamu 10 zvemvura nechikamu 1 checoncentrate. (Muenzaniso: 100 mL concentrate + 1,000 mL mvura = 1,100 mL mvura yakasanganiswa)
y-m-76-03.s.s3.model.1: Concentrate : mvura = 1 : 10. Pakapu 1 yeconcentrate, makapu 10 emvura. Kugadzira 1 L, inenge 91 mL yeconcentrate nenge 909 mL yemvura.

y-m-76-10.title: Kana tichigadzira ma item codes matsva, tinofanira kushandisa mabhii mangani uye madhijiti mangani?
y-m-76-10.goal: Ziva kuti huwandu hwema codes anogona kugadzirwa hunotarwa sei kana zvisarudzo zvichitevedzana pachikamu chega chega, uye ugadzire madhizaini akawanda anogutsa mamiriro ose pahuwandu hunodiwa nehurefu.
y-m-76-10.material: Tiri kugadzira ma item codes matsva eware house. Code ine chimiro chekunyora 'a uppercase letters' kutanga wozonyora 'd digits' (semuenzaniso, kana a=2 uye d=3, code senge KT482). Kune letters, tinoshandisa marudzi 24 chete, tichisiya O ne I, uye kune dhijiti rega rega tinoshandisa 0 kusvika ku9. Pane mitemo mitatu. Wekutanga, huwandu hwema codes akasiyana anogona kugadzirwa hunofanira kuva 30,000 kana kupfuura yezvinhu zvichashandiswa kubva zvino. Wechipiri, kuti pasave nema codes asingashandiswi akawandisa, hunofanira kuva 600,000 kana pasi. Wechitatu, urefu hwe code a + d hunofanira kuva 5 kana pasi.
y-m-76-10.prereq.1: Nzira yekutanga yekuverenga nyaya (middle-school level): huwandu hwenzira dzekusarudza zvinhu nenhevedzano
y-m-76-10.s.s1.prompt: Mushandi akaverenga huwandu hwema codes anogona kugadzirwa ne code system ye a=2, d=2 sezvizvi pazasi. Sarudza mutsara wekutanga unotadza.
y-m-76-10.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira kuti ibhii rekutanga rakagadziriswa, uye uverenge kuti mabhii mangani anogona kuuya pachigaro chebhii rechipiri.
y-m-76-10.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora iwe pachako ma codes mashoma kune muenzaniso mudiki (bhii 1 nedhijiti 1) uye uenzanise nenzira yemushandi.

y-m-76-10.s.s1.line.2: Saka huwandu hwema codes akasiyana ndi24 + 24 + 10 + 10 = 68.
y-m-76-10.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 3 unotadza. Kunyange mushure mekusarudza chigaro chimwe, chigaro chinotevera chinogona kusarudzwa kubva pazvinogoneka zvose, saka unofanira kuwedzera nenhevedzano, kwete kuwedzera huwandu hwezvisarudzo. 24 × 24 × 10 × 10 = 57,600. Mhedziso yemutsara 4 yakabva pakukosha kwakashata uku, saka nekukosha kwakarurama inochinja.
y-m-76-10.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mapeya 3 akasiyana (huwandu hwema letters a, huwandu hwemadhijiti d) anogutsa mitemo mitatu yose.
y-m-76-10.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza a imwe ne d imwe, verenga huwandu hwema codes, uye utarise kuti huri mukati memarenji maviri (30,000 kana kupfuura uye 600,000 kana pasi).
y-m-76-10.s.s2.hint.1: Kana huri kunze kwerenji, chinja a kana d ne1 uye utarise zvakare.

y-m-76-10.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza imwe yemadhizaini awakagadzira uye unyore mubairo mumwe nekushaya kumwe. Shandisa huwandu hwema codes (nhamba) kamwe kana kupfuura.

y-m-76-05.title: Bhiri remvura yeimba yakashandisa 30 m³: yakakanganisa kupi?
y-m-76-05.goal: Mumitengo apo mutengo pamuyuniti unosiyana nedanho, verenga zvakarurama uchiparadzanisa chikamu chinoshandiswa nemutengo pamuyuniti mumwe nemumwe, uye ugadzire huwandu hwekushandisa hunoenderana nemamiriro.
y-m-76-05.material: Tebhura remitengo yemvura yakagadzirwa. Bhiri remwedzi = mari yekutanga 2,000원 + mari inoenderana nekushandisa. Kusvika ku 20 m³ yekushandisa i 600원 pa 1 m³, uye pachikamu chiri pamusoro pe 20 m³ chete i 900원 pa 1 m³. Kushandisa kunoverengwa mu m³ dzakazara chete. Pazasi pane memo apo mushandi akaverenga bhiri reimba yakashandisa 30 m³ (nhamba dzemitsetse dzinotanga ne 1).
y-m-76-05.thinking.2: Kugadzira huwandu hwakati wandei hwekushandisa hunogutsa mamiriro
y-m-76-05.prereq.2: Kuwana mutengo we linear expression (padanho regiredhi re1 re middle school)
y-m-76-05.s.s1.hint.0: Wana mumutsetse upi wememo mamiriro e 'chikamu chiri pamusoro chete' mutebhura remitengo akaratidzwa.
y-m-76-05.s.s1.hint.1: Patsanura 30 m³ kuita 20 m³ nechikamu chiri pamusoro payo, uye uwanze chimwe nechimwe nemutengo wacho pamuyuniti.
y-m-76-05.s.s1.line.1: 30 m³ i yakawanda kupfuura 20 m³, saka wanza 30 m³ yese ne 900원: 30 × 900 = 27,000원.
y-m-76-05.s.s1.line.3: Naizvozvo bhiri remwedzi reimba yakashandisa 30 m³ i 29,000원.
y-m-76-05.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 2 wakakanganisa. 900원 inoshanda pa 10 m³ yakapfuura 20 m³ chete. Kuverenga kwakarurama i 2,000 + 20 × 600 + 10 × 900 = 23,000원. Mitsetse 3 ne 4 yakatora mutengo wemutsetse 2.
y-m-76-05.s.s2.prompt: Pasina kuverenga zvakare, chii chiri hwaro hwakavimbika zvikuru hwekusahadzika kuti 29,000원 inoshamisa?
y-m-76-05.s.s2.hint.0: Shandisa nzira yememo iyi ku 20 m³ ne 21 m³ imwe neimwe.
y-m-76-05.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga kuti bhiri rinofanira kuwedzera zvakadini mutebhura remitengo chaiyo kana ukashandisa 1 m³ yakawanda, uye uenzanise.

y-m-76-05.s.s2.o.b: Mari yekutanga ye 2,000원 i duku zvakanyanya kana yaenzaniswa nemari yekushandisa, saka yakaipa
y-m-76-05.s.s2.r.b: Kuenzanisa hukuru hwemari yekutanga nemari yekushandisa hakuna chekuita nekuti kuverenga kwakarurama here.
y-m-76-05.s.s2.o.c: Mutengo pamuyuniti wakanzi 900원, saka kuwanza 30 ne 900 hakuna dambudziko uye hapana chikonzero chekusahadzika
y-m-76-05.s.s2.r.c: Wakawanza pakarepo usina kuverenga kuti mutengo pamuyuniti unoshanda pachikamu chipi mutebhura.
y-m-76-05.s.s2.explain: Kushandisa nzira imwechete yekuverenga ku 20 m³ ne 21 m³, panguva apo mutengo pamuyuniti unochinja kubva ku 600원 kuenda ku 900원 bhiri rinosvetuka ne 6,900원 pakarepo. Izvi zvinopokana netebhura remitengo apo mari yeyawedzerwa 1 m³ chete ndiyo inofanira kuwedzera.
y-m-76-05.s.s3.prompt: Gadzira huwandu hwekushandisa 3 hwakasiyana x (m³) apo bhiri remwedzi i 25,000원 kana kupfuura uye shoma kupfuura 30,000원.

y-m-76-05.s.s3.fail.c1: Kushandisa kunofanira kuva integer kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 100.
y-m-76-05.s.s3.explain: Bhiri kusvika ku 20 m³ i 14,000원. Pamusoro peizvozvo, 900원 inowedzerwa pa 1 m³ imwe neimwe, saka x = 33 i 25,700원 uye x = 37 i 29,300원. 32 m³ i 24,800원 uye 38 m³ i 30,200원, iyo i kunze kwerange. Integer chero ipi kubva ku 33 kusvika ku 37 i mhinduro.

y-m-76-09.title: Chigadzirwa chakarira alarm chine mukana we90% wekuva ne defect here?
y-m-76-09.topic: Conditional probability: hukama pakati pe alarm ne defect
y-m-76-09.goal: Tarisa nekuverenga kuti 'kana ine defect, alarm inorira' ne 'alarm yakarira, saka ine defect' zvirevo zvakasiyana, uye ushande iwe pachako kuti kukosha kunochinja sei kana defect rate ichichinja.
y-m-76-09.material: Muchina wekutarisa wefekitori unorira alarm nemukana we90% kana chigadzirwa chine defect, uye kunyange kuchigadzirwa chakanaka unorira alarm nemukana we5% (false alarm). Kunze kwe alarm iyi, hapana nzira yekuziva kana chigadzirwa chine defect. Defect rate (chikamu chezvinhu zvine defect pakati pezvigadzirwa zvose) inogona kusiyana kubva pamutsara kuenda kuimwe.
y-m-76-09.thinking.1: Kutsvaga defect rates dzakawanda dzinokodzera mamiriro
y-m-76-09.s.s1.prompt: Nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo painowedzera rumwe, chinja kutonga kwako nezve 'mukana wekuti chigadzirwa chakarira alarm chine defect chaizvo'.
y-m-76-09.s.s1.hint.0: Paradzanisa zvinhu 1,000 kuita zvine defect nezvakanaka, uye unyore, setafura, huwandu hweimwe neimwe umo alarm inorira.
y-m-76-09.s.s1.hint.1: Unganidza zvinhu zvakarira alarm chete uye uverenge kuti zvingani zvine defect.
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.0.info: Kuita kwemuchina chete (alarm 90% kana ine defect, 5% kana yakanaka) ndiko kunozikanwa. Hatizivi kuti ma defects akajairika zvakadii.
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kutonga kwakakodzera kunobata probability yekuti chigadzirwa chakarira alarm chine defect chaizvo ndekupi?
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.0.after: Chikamu chezvinhu zvine defect pakati pezvakarira alarm chinoenderana nekuti ma defects akajairika zvikuru kana kuti haawanzoitiki, saka hazvigoni kutongwa kubva paruzivo urwu oga.
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakaverenga 90% probability ye 'alarm kana ine defect' se probability ye 'ine defect kana alarm yarira'.
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Hazvigoni kutongwa kunze kwekunge tichiziva kuti ma defects akajairika zvakadii
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ndianenge 50%, nekuti ine defect kana isina, imwe yemaviri
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kuva nenyaya mbiri hakureve kuti ma probabilities akaenzana.
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.1.info: Pamutsara uyu, zvinhu 20 pakati pe1,000 (2%) zvine defect. Alarm inorira kune 18, ndiyo 90% ye20 dzine defect, uye kune 49, ndiyo 5% ye980 dzakanaka.
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.1.ask: Probability yekuti chigadzirwa chakarira alarm chine defect chaizvo ndeipi?
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.1.after: Pakati pezvigadzirwa 67 zvakarira alarm, 18 dzine defect, saka ndianenge 26.9%. Pamutsara apo ma defects asingawanzoitiki, pane false alarms dzakawanda kupfuura true alarms.
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Zvigadzirwa zvakarira alarm ndi18 + 49 = 67, uye 18 chete dzine defect.
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Anenge 5%, probability yekuti chigadzirwa chakanaka chipe false alarm
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.1.r.b: 5% ndiyo probability yekuti chigadzirwa chakanaka chipe false alarm. Inosiyana nechikamu chezvinhu zvine defect pakati pezvakarira alarm.
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.2.info: Pane imwe mutsara, zvinhu 100 pakati pe1,000 (10%) zvine defect. Alarm inorira kune 90 pakati pe100 dzine defect uye kune 45 pakati pe900 dzakanaka.
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.2.ask: Probability yekuti chigadzirwa chakarira alarm chine defect chaizvo pamutsara uyu inoenzaniswa sei neyemutsara wapfuura?
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.2.after: Pakati pe135 dzakarira alarm, 90 dzine defect, anenge 66.7%. Kunyange nemuchina mumwe chete, ma defects akajairika zvakawanda, zvinova nemukana mukuru wekuti chigadzirwa chakarira alarm chine defect chaizvo.
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Inoramba yakafanana chaizvo neyemutsara wapfuura, anenge 27%
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kuita kwemuchina kufanana hakureve kuti mhedzisiro yakafanana. Kuti ma defects akajairika zvakadii kwakachinja.
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Inova diki panzvimbo, anenge 10%, nhanho ye defect rate
y-m-76-09.s.s1.st.2.r.c: 10% ndiyo defect rate yemutsara uyu chete. Unofanira kuverenga zvakare uchitarisa zvigadzirwa zvakarira alarm chete.
y-m-76-09.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga paiva neruzivo rushoma zvikuru, saka 'hazvigoni kutongwa' zvaikodzera; kana defect rate yapiwa, takaverenga ndokuwana kukosha; uye kana defect rate yakachinja, kukosha kwakachinja zvikuru. Ngatitaure kuti nei mhedzisiro yakasiyana kunyange kuita kwemuchina kwakafanana.
y-m-76-09.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira defect rates p% 3 dzakasiyana apo probability yekuti chigadzirwa chakarira alarm chine defect chaizvo iri 50% kana kupfuura. (p ndi integer kubva ku1 kusvika ku50, uye kuita kwemuchina kwakafanana sepamusoro)
y-m-76-09.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza defect rate uye uverenge, pakati pe100, zvinhu zvine defect nezvakanaka umo alarm inorira.
y-m-76-09.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga muganhu apo huwandu hwema alarms padivi rine defect hunova hukuru kupfuura huwandu hwema alarms padivi rezvakanaka.
y-m-76-09.s.s2.ok.c1: Ndi integer kubva ku1 kusvika ku50.
y-m-76-09.s.s2.fail.c1: Defect rate inofanira kuva % yenhamba yakazara kubva ku1 kusvika ku50.
y-m-76-09.s.s2.ok.c2: Probability yekuti chigadzirwa chakarira alarm chine defect ndi50% kana kupfuura.
y-m-76-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Probability yekuti chigadzirwa chakarira alarm chine defect iri pasi pe50%.
y-m-76-09.s.s2.explain: Kana defect rate iri p%, saka pakati pe100 dzega dzega, pakati pe p dzine defect alarm inorira kune 0.9p, uye pakati pe 100 − p dzakanaka inorira kune 0.05 × (100 − p). Kuti divi rine defect rive hafu kana kupfuura, 0.9p ≥ 0.05 × (100 − p), zvinoreva p ≥ anenge 5.3. Saka seinteger, p ≥ 6.
y-m-76-09.s.s3.prompt: Nyora notice yemutsara mumwe yenzvimbo yebasa pamusoro pekuti mushandi anofanira kupindura sei kana alarm ichirira. Nyorawo kuti nei alarm isingareve kuti chigadzirwa chasimbiswa kuva ne defect.
y-m-76-09.s.s3.hint.0: Rangarira kuti zvigadzirwa zvakarira alarm mumadanho ari pamusoro zvakanaka zvingani.
y-m-76-09.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora chokwadi icho mumutsara mumwe, wozonyora chinhu chimwe chekuita zvinotevera.
y-m-76-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mushandi anoverenga mashoko aya anorega kurasa zvigadzirwa zvakarira alarm pakarepo here?
y-m-76-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakafunga here kuti mashoko anofanira kusiyana pakati pemutsara une defect rate yakaderera neune yakakwirira here?
y-m-76-09.s.s3.model.0: Kunyange alarm ikarira, haisi defect yakasimbiswa. Inogona kuva false alarm, saka isa padivi uye uitarise kamwe zvakare.
y-m-76-09.s.s3.model.1: Pamutsara une defect rate yakaderera, pangava nezvigadzirwa zvakanaka zvakawanda pakati pezvakarira alarm. Usarase pakarepo; tarisa zvakare.

y-m-76-13.title: Tinofanira kugadzirira masanduichi mangani: kutarisa avhareji yezvinodiwa kunokwana here?
y-m-76-13.goal: Enzanisa purofiti inotarisirwa pahuwandu hwega hwega hwokugadzirira kubva pakuparadzirwa kwezvinodiwa, wedzera chimwe chiyero se nyaya yakaipisisa, uye utsvage huwandu hwakati wandei hwokugadzirira hunosangana namamiriro.
y-m-76-13.material: Chitoro chidiki chinogadzira nokutengesa masanduichi mangwanani ose. Kugadzira rimwe kunodhura 2,000원 uye rinotengeswa 5,000원. Asina kutengeswa ose anodzingwa. Mumazuva 20 apfuura, zvinodiwa zvezuva nezuva (huwandu hwevatengi vanokumbira) zvaiva 10 pamazuva 4, 12 pamazuva 6, 14 pamazuva 6, uye 16 pamazuva 4. Fungidzira kuti zvichaenderera mberi zvichionekwa nemareshiyo akafanana. Huwandu hwokugadzirira hunosarudzwa senhamba yakazara kubva pa 10 kusvika pa 16, uye purofiti yezuva nezuva = huwandu hwakatengeswa × 5,000 − huwandu hwakagadzirirwa × 2,000.

y-m-76-13.s.s1.r.a: Wakafungidzira kuti avhareji yezvinodiwa nehuwandu hune purofiti inotarisirwa huru zvikuru zvakafanana. Kana kurasikirwa kunobva pazvinosara nepurofiti yakashayikwa kubva pazvisina kutengeswa zvakasiyana muhukuru, zvinogona kusiyana.
y-m-76-13.s.s1.o.b: Kurasikirwa kunobva pazvinosara nepurofiti yakashayikwa zvakasiyana, saka huwandu hwakanakisa hwokugadzirira hungasiyana neavhareji
